entry.title: New: Bill 90 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM, GRANTS AND DISBURSEMENTS FOR BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHAINA TOWN ACTION COMMITTEE; GRANTS AND DISBURSEMENTS FOR CULTURE, ARTS, AND TOURISM" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, to increase the appropriation for the Lahaina Town Action Committee by $10,000 and to delete the appropriation for Lahaina Boat Day.
